storyCards.fact:
Eve's "Satisfaction" reached #27 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Satisfaction" is a hip-hop song by American rapper-songwriter Eve, released on February 25, 2003, as the second and final single from the album, Eve-Olution (2002).

The song peaked at #27 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 16 weeks on the chart.

Satisfaction was released in 2002.
